best_idea: A per-entity regen accumulator on a fixed 1 s tick where each action lowers only the next tick's points, with per-level pool gains from stat bonuses plus a class roll, capped per class.
decision_why: Frankendom has stamina and HP pools without per-level growth yet; the accumulator-with-action-penalty and capped per-class level gain are small engine steps that fit the server tick, with the donor numbers moved to catalogue data and defects D1-D5 fixed.
acceptance: A server test asserts that a player who attacks in a tick recovers exactly a quarter of an idle tick's regen points on the next tick, that a moving player recovers half, and that a level-up adds at most the class cap minus current max HP.
